title: Admin, Service Manager and Parts Manager see the status and tracking controls
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • The system roles Service Manager, Parts Manager and Service Advisor have been reset to their template, so earlier edits on this shared environment do not skew the result.
  • Staff members {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL-DEFROLE-SM) with the Service Manager role, {User-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL-DEFROLE-PM) with the Parts Manager role and {User-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL-DEFROLE-SA) with the Service Advisor role work at {Location-A}.
  • A second browser window (for example a private window) is used to sign in as each of them in turn.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DEFROLE-01) is active and tracked at {Location-A}, with 2 in {Bin-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the Admin window open Parts → Inventory and click the ⋮ actions menu.
  2. Press Esc, search {Part-A} and click its row.
  3. Look at the footer, the Part Status choice and the Track quantities and cost of goods switch, then click Cancel.
  4. In the second window sign in as {User-B} and repeat Steps 1 to 3.
  5. Sign out, sign in as {User-C} and repeat Steps 1 to 3.
  6. Sign out, sign in as {User-D} and repeat Steps 1 to 3.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: The Admin's menu shows Deactivate parts.
  • Steps 1 to 6: For every user, the status and tracking controls are available exactly when Delete Part is shown in the dialog.
  • Step 3: The Admin's dialog shows the red Delete Part button, Part Status can be changed and the switch can be changed.
  • Step 4: The same four controls show and work for {User-B} (Service Manager).
  • Step 5: The same four controls show and work for {User-C} (Parts Manager).
  • Step 6: For {User-D} (Service Advisor) Delete Part is not shown, and equally Deactivate parts is missing from the menu, Part Status is disabled and the switch is disabled.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S8-R14 and §4 Key Decisions (Access does not change), read 13 Oct 2026. Roles are reset to template before a permission check on a shared environment (playbook §G). Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R14: “The controls this spec gates on the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission show to exactly the users who see Delete on the part dialog today. By default those are Admin, Service Manager and Parts Manager.”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions: “The controls show to exactly the users who see Delete on the part dialog today.”
